PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE FOR THE 3-YEAR SEWER SERVICE CHARGE INCREASE
It is recommended that the City Council 1) open the public and protest hearing; 2) hear all oral and written testimony; 3) close the public and protest hearing; 4) determine the number of protests received; 5) introduce Ordinance No. 08-873, amending Section 4.10.040 entitled Calculation of Charge of Chapter 4.10 (Sewer Charges) to increase the sewer service charge for the next three (3) years. (Reading waived and read by title only at meeting of July 8, 2008.)

CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION AND PROMISSORY NOTE TO COVER COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION LOAN WITH BANK OF THE WEST
